verdict.rationale: A dedicated first-party MCP docs page says MCP can give "ChatGPT or Codex" access to third-party tools and documentation, such as browsers or Figma. It shows adding a server (Context7), stores configuration in `config.toml` with per-project scoping via `.codex/config.toml`, and notes that configured servers carry across clients without redoing setup. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool use works in practice, and documented setup for the ChatGPT chat/Work surfaces (configuration details shown are Codex-centric).
